description: Variation of Condition 2 of approved planning permission 3852/22: remove the second staircase to comply with BS 9991:2024, with associated changes to the building footprint and internal layout, including alterations to access to maintenance areas, minor apartment reconfigurations, the addition of 2no. smoke extraction units at roof level and updates to the extent of the roof terrace to meet current fire safety guidance. (Summary).
